rows.note: Three attempts through TabbyAPI produced no translation at all before the tapes in assets/ were read: summary.server.kind on every GLM take here is `exllamav3`, not tabbyAPI, and ~/tabbyAPI-config.yml says in its own first line that it exists for the #454 check. The rate above is from exl3-serve with the recorded arguments. Their -cs 8192 came from a short-prompt streaming demo; at 3 129 prompt tokens it capped generation at 4 096 and cut the answer, and -cs 16384 never became healthy at -gs 44,21 in 26 minutes, so the run stands as the truncated one. The structure gate passed it at 1 FAIL: table shape and block count survive when a table is left untranslated, which is a hole in that gate worth naming

Solar Open 2 was read over all 33 blocks against Opus, V4.1 and Gemma 4 with the labels shuffled, and scored 1 meaning change — but so did V4.1 and Gemma 4 in that same sitting, which found 2 where the ladder's sitting found 7, so the sitting is the less sensitive one and its counts do not belong in this column. What it does say is that the three are tied. GLM was never read this way at all, and its column is identifiable by its broken characters.
read_note_ko: † 사다리의 계측으로 재지 않았다. Solar Open 2는 33블록 전부를 Opus·V4.1·Gemma 4와 라벨 가린 채 읽어 의미 오류 1건이 나왔는데, 같은 자리에서 V4.1도 Gemma 4도 1건이었다 — 사다리 판정이 7건을 찾은 자리에서 이 판정은 2건을 찾았으니, 덜 예민한 자이고 그 숫자는 이 열에 들어갈 수 없다. 대신 말해 주는 것은 셋이 동률이라는 사실이다. GLM은 이런 식으로 읽힌 적이 아예 없고, 깨진 문자 때문에 열이 식별된다.
